en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Sa’alba, from Mo’mar Bin Umar Bin Ata’a, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Pride is a Gown of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and the arrogant one disputes Allah<sup>azwj</sup> about His<sup>azwj</sup> Gown’.
en.sarwar: 4. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn Faddal from Tha’labah from Mu’ammar ibn ‘Umar ibn ‘Ata’ from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Pride is the gown of Allah. An arrogant person (assuming arrogance) disputes Allah about His gown.”
